events.title: China Exports Growth Beats Expectations
events.description: China exports growth accelerated more-than-expected in September on strong demand for hi-tech products, suggesting that overseas demand will help counteract the economic slowdown brought on by domestic demand and investment. Exports logged a sharp growth of 36.3 percent in September, bigger than the 25.0 percent rise in August, the General Administration of Customs reported Wednesday.

events.title: European Shares Poised For Firm Start Ahead Of US Inflation Test
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a firm note on Wednesday as investors await the release of a closely watched report on U.S. consumer price inflation for directional cues.

events.title: Indian Shares Little Changed After Strong Rally
events.description: Indian shares were little changed on Wednesday after logging strong gains in the previous session, led by information technology stocks.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Wednesday, snapping a three-session winning streak, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling well below the 8,750 level, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian markets are mostly higher on Wednesday, despite the negative cues from Wall Street overnight, boosted by a rebound in technology and semiconductor stocks in Japan and South Korea after the recent sharp sell-off. Support also came from comments by New York Fed President John Williams that while one more rate hike might happen this year, aggressive further tightening may not be needed in 2027.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Flat On Dovish Fed Comments
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening on a flat note on Wednesday, with dovish Fed comments likely to limit potential losses, if any.

events.title: Thai Shares May Tick Lower On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the five-day winning streak in which it had gained almost 25 points or 1.6 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,570-point plateau and it's likely to see little movement again on Wednesday.

events.title: Continued Consolidation Likely For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved lower in two straight sessions, sinking almost 170 points or 2.9 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,925-point plateau and it may take further damage again on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading modestly higher on Wednesday, snapping a four-session losing streak, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 68,000 mark, with gains in exporters, automakers and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in financial stocks.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished higher in three straight sessions, gathering almost 575 points or 2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 24,350-point plateau although it may open in the red on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: Australian stock markets are trading notably lower on Wednesday, snapping a three-session winning streak, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling well below the 8,750 level, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks. Meanwhile, iron ore miners and gold miners are mixed.

events.title: China Bourse Likely Rangebound Again On Wednesday
events.description: The China stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 20 points or 0.5 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,800-point plateau and it's likely to remain in that neighborhood again on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore GDP Gains 1.1% In Q3
events.description: Singapore's gross domestic product expanded a seasonally adjusted 1.1 percent on quarter in the third quarter of 2026, the Singapore Department of Statistics said in Wednesday's advance estimate.
